parameters.content:
# 🔎 Job Scout
**Automated daily job search across 6 boards.**

Fetches, scores, and AI-evaluates listings every morning — then emails you only the best matches.

**Quick Setup:**
1. Replace every `YOUR_*` placeholder with a real value
2. Assign credentials: Gmail · Google Sheets · OpenRouter
3. Upload your resume PDF to Google Drive
4. Configure keywords in **Smart Scorer** + Fetch nodes
5. Activate the workflow!

📖 See **README.md** for full setup guide.

## ⚙️ Step 1 — Initialization
Triggered daily (default **7 AM UTC**). Loads your resume and reads your Google Sheets history to build a preference profile.

**Configure these nodes:**
- **Schedule Trigger** → change `triggerAtHour` to your preferred time
- **Get Resume** → replace `YOUR_GOOGLE_DRIVE_RESUME_FILE_ID` (file must be publicly viewable)
- **Read Applied History** → replace `YOUR_GOOGLE_SHEETS_ID`

## 🔍 Step 2 — Fetch from 6 Job Boards
All sources run **in parallel**. Each requires a free API key or token (see README for signup links).

- **Fetch Google Jobs** → replace `YOUR_SERPAPI_KEY` and `YOUR_SEARCH_KEYWORDS` in the URL
- **Fetch Adzuna Jobs** → replace `YOUR_ADZUNA_APP_ID` and `YOUR_ADZUNA_APP_KEY` in query params
- **Apify (Indeed)** → replace `YOUR_APIFY_TOKEN`; set `"position"` to your job title
- **Fetch LinkedIn Jobs (Apify)** → replace `YOUR_APIFY_TOKEN`; set `"keywords"` to your role
- **Fetch Jooble Jobs** → replace `YOUR_JOOBLE_API_KEY` in the URL path; set `"keywords"` in the body
- **RemoteOK** → free public feed, no key needed ✓

**Set Location & Position Parameters** → edit the `what`/`where` pairs for Adzuna keyword searches

## 🔗 Step 3 — Normalize & Merge
All 6 sources are normalized into a unified schema:
`{ title, company, description, location, link, pay, date }`

Then merged into a single stream for deduplication.

**No configuration needed here.**

## 🧹 Step 4 — Deduplicate & Filter
**Deduplicate** → removes listings seen across multiple boards (matched by title + company).
**Filter Out Seen Jobs** → skips jobs already saved to your Google Sheet (no repeat emails).

⚠️ **Filter by Location** → open this node and edit `ALLOWED_LOCATIONS`:
- Remote/hybrid jobs are **always** kept
- Add your target cities and state abbreviation
- Example: `'austin', 'dallas', ', tx'`

## ⭐ Step 5 — Smart Scoring
Keyword-based scoring **before** AI — cheaply filters irrelevant jobs so you don't waste AI credits.

Only jobs scoring **> 0** reach the AI evaluator.

⚠️ **Remove titles** → add keywords for job titles you never want (e.g. `'sales'`, `'intern'`)
⚠️ **Smart Scorer** → edit `CORE_FUNCTION_KEYWORDS` with terms for your target role. Higher point values = stronger relevance signal.

## 🤖 Step 6 — Application Email Drafting
**Routing is now purely quantitative.** `Score Router` (IF node) checks `score >= 0` from the pre-screener:
- **True** → job goes through the AI loop below and gets a drafted application email
- **False** → job skips the AI entirely and is logged straight to the `Declined` tab (see Step 7)

For passing jobs, `Job Application Email Writer` (OpenAI `gpt-4o-mini` via the same `OpenAI Chat Model (Evaluator)` connector) writes a tailored **application email** (subject + body, cover-letter style) referencing that job's actual requirements and the candidate's resume. Jobs are processed in batches of 1 with an 8s `Wait1` between calls to respect rate limits.

⚠️ The old **`Job Match Evaluator`** (confidence_score/summary/fit_reason) and old **`Only scores > 0`** filter are disabled and disconnected from the live path — kept on canvas only as a rollback reference. Do not re-enable without also rewiring them.

## 📤 Step 7 — Draft, Save & Log
**Passing jobs** (`score >= 0`): `JSON Parser` parses the email-writer's JSON → `Create Gmail Draft` saves it as a **Gmail draft only (never sent, "To" left blank for you to fill in)** → `Google Sheets` appends the full record to **`Sheet1`** with `Draft Email Created = Yes`.

**Declined jobs** (`score < 0`): routed directly from `Score Router`'s false branch to `Append Declined Jobs`, which appends the full record to the **`Declined`** tab with `Draft Email Created = No` — no AI call, no email.

Both branches merge at `Merge Results` before `Summarize Run Results` → `Log Run Complete`, so the `Runs` tab's `resultsCount` reflects everything processed (applied + declined).

⚠️ **`Create Gmail Draft`** → needs a **Gmail OAuth2 credential** attached (none configured yet — must be added via the n8n UI, OAuth2 can't be set via API).
⚠️ **`Declined` tab** must be created manually in the spreadsheet (same as the `Runs` tab was) before this will work.

💡 **Shared column schema (both `Sheet1` and `Declined`):**
`Job Title | Company Name | Pay | Link | Quantitative Score | Location | Matched Keywords | source | savedAt | Run ID | Draft Email Created | Email Subject`

parameters.text:
=You are an expert career coach and professional email writer. This job has already cleared a quantitative keyword-match pre-screen (score {{ $json["score"] }}) — your job is to write the candidate's application email for it, tailored to this specific role, using their resume.

**Instructions:**
1. Write a concise, professional application email (100-160 words) in the candidate's voice, plain prose only — no bullet points, no markdown, no headers. Structure:
   - Opening line: state the job title and company being applied to.
   - 1-2 sentences: highlight the candidate's most relevant experience/skills from their resume that match THIS job's specific requirements (name real technologies/skills from the job description that the resume actually supports — do not invent experience).
   - Closing line: mention the resume is attached for review and invite further discussion.
   - Do not add a signature line (e.g. "Best regards, [Name]") unless the resume clearly states the candidate's full name — if it does, end with "Best regards," followed by that name; otherwise end at the closing sentence.
   Match this reference example's tone and length exactly:

   Dear Hiring Manager,

   I am applying for the Backend Developer (PHP/Laravel) position at FACILINK.

   I have 6+ years of experience in PHP/Laravel development with strong knowledge of REST APIs, MySQL, and third party integrations. I have built secure backend systems, optimized database performance, and worked with Git to deliver clean, reliable, and production ready applications.

   My resume is attached for your review. I would welcome the opportunity to discuss how my experience can support your team.

2. Write an `email_subject` line, e.g. "Application for {Job Title} at {Company}" (adapt naturally to the role).
3. Extract `pay` from the job data if available, otherwise return "N/A".
4. You MUST respond with a valid JSON object only. Do not include any text, code fences, or explanations outside of the JSON structure.

**Input Data:**
- Job Score (from pre-screener): {{ $json["score"] }}
- Matched Keywords (from pre-screener): {{ $json["reason"] }}
- Job Title: {{ $json["title"] }}
- Company: {{ $json["company"] }}
- Description: {{ $json["description"] }}
- Resume: {{ $json["resume"] }}

**Required JSON Output Format:**
{
  "title": "{{$json["title"]}}",
  "company": "{{$json["company"]}}",
  "link": "{{$json["link"]}}",
  "location": "{{$json["location"]}}",
  "pay": "<extracted pay or N/A>",
  "score": {{$json["score"]}},
  "source": "{{ $json.source }}",
  "matched_keywords": "{{ $json.reason }}",
  "email_subject": "<your subject line>",
  "email_body": "<your email body>"
}
